scope: This pointer names two existing published commitments by their exact bytes. It adds no measurement and is not a grade, ranking or endorsement of anything named. The two corpora are separate: card count here is the mill card-root leaf count, separate from /signed/card_index.json, /root.json and /api/gspc.

card_root.leaf_rule: leaf = sha256 of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) of the whole signed card in /interop/mill-cards-signed/
card_root.tree_rule: leaves in published index order (ascending leaf hex); node = sha256(left || right), no domain prefix; an odd last node is paired with itself (scripts/publish_public_root.py merkle_root)

capsule_index.rule: RFC 6962 Merkle Tree Hash over the 32-byte capsule_id leaves sorted ascending: leaf = SHA-256(0x00 || capsule_id), node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right), split at the largest power of two smaller than n; no leaf promoted or duplicated. index_root = same rule over the union of capsule_ids of all batches
